investigations.name: caspule-nfsim-dimer
investigations.description: Baseline dimerization study: couples CASPULE bond-aware MD to NFSim rule-based kinetics via the ObservableDetector bridge. Tracks spatial bond counts (CASPULE side) and non-spatial species pools (NFSim side).
investigations.title: CASPULE-NFSim Dimerization
investigations.objective: How does spatial bond-formation in a CASPULE LJ monomer gas feed molecule counts into downstream NFSim rule-based kinetics, and what does the coupled temporal trajectory of dimer counts and thermo state look like?

investigations.name: caspule-nfsim-polymer
investigations.description: Polymer fractionation study: demonstrates size-selective coupling between spatial bond clusters in CASPULE and a multi-species NFSim kinetics model.
investigations.title: CASPULE-NFSim Polymer Fractionation
investigations.objective: How does size-based fractionation of spatial bond clusters (dimers, trimers, and larger polymers) into distinct NFSim molecule species shape the downstream non-spatial activation and decay kinetics?
